name: match_id
description: Match identifier, joins matches.match_id. 1..104 in chronological order.

name: stage
description: Stage: Group stage, Round of 32, Round of 16, Quarter-final, Semi-final, Third place, Final.

name: stage_order
description: Stage order for sorting: 1 = Group stage ... 6 = Third place, 7 = Final.

name: group_letter
description: Group letter A..L for group-stage matches, NULL otherwise.

name: team
description: The team this row is about (English name).

name: goals_for
description: Goals scored by `team` after extra time (own goals by the opponent included, shoot-out excluded).

name: goals_against
description: Goals conceded by `team` after extra time.

name: extra_time
description: TRUE if the match went to extra time.

name: penalties_for
description: Shoot-out score of `team`, NULL if no shoot-out.

name: penalties_against
description: Shoot-out score of the opponent, NULL if no shoot-out.

name: result
description: W, D or L for `team`. Shoot-out wins are W, shoot-out losses L.
